items.reason: Describes the same ownership-check bypass when a missing Integration row causes the pipeline to advance without verifying the installer.
Describes the same unguarded sender metadata lookup causing KeyError and a 500 when sender is absent.
Describes the same KeyError from directly indexing optional sender metadata in the ownership check.
Describes the same missing-sender metadata crash and proposes handling the absence as a verification failure.
Describes the same unhandled KeyError when the ownership check reads metadata without a sender entry.
Describes the same unhandled transport failures from the OAuth token request occurring outside the try block.
Describes the same loss of translation extraction caused by passing a variable to gettext instead of marking the short-message literals.
Describes the same unconditional sender metadata lookup that crashes when sender is missing.
Describes the same predictable pipeline signature used as OAuth state instead of a random per-attempt nonce.
Objects to the timing behavior of the state comparison, not the deterministic state value. Changing the comparison to constant-time would not fix issue #03.
Identifies the same incorrect OAuth state in test_installation_not_found, which makes the test fail before reaching its intended installation-not-found path.

Claims insufficient branch-specific assertions in test_github_user_mismatch, a different test that supplies the correct OAuth state. Fixing those assertions would not fix the incorrect state in test_installation_not_found.
